Blocking with a clear message feels safer than merging. Merging could unexpectedly overwrite notes, labels, or read status. The message should identify the existing bookmark, as it does, and ideally offer a simple way to open that existing entry for editing.

For opening links, I prefer Version B: clicking the title or site icon opens the original page in a new tab. It feels familiar, avoids accidental openings when clicking elsewhere on the card, and keeps my bookmark list available.
